CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_conversation_participant(conv_id UUID)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations
    WHERE id = conv_id AND auth.uid() = ANY(participants)
  )
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_blocked(user_a uuid, user_b uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.blocked_users
    WHERE (blocker_id = user_a AND blocked_id = user_b)
       OR (blocker_id = user_b AND blocked_id = user_a)
  )
$$;

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_profile(profile_id uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT (
    -- Own profile
    auth.uid() = profile_id
    OR (
      -- Not blocked AND has contextual relationship
      NOT public.is_blocked(auth.uid(), profile_id)
      AND (
        EXISTS (
          -- Users with matching journeys (same train + date)
          SELECT 1 FROM journeys j1
          INNER JOIN journeys j2 ON j1.train_number = j2.train_number 
            AND j1.travel_date = j2.travel_date
          WHERE j1.user_id = auth.uid() 
            AND j2.user_id = profile_id
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          -- Users with accepted companion requests
          SELECT 1 FROM requests
          WHERE status = 'accepted'
            AND ((from_user_id = auth.uid() AND to_user_id = profile_id)
                 OR (to_user_id = auth.uid() AND from_user_id = profile_id))
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          -- Users in active conversations
          SELECT 1 FROM conversations
          WHERE auth.uid() = ANY(participants)
            AND profile_id = ANY(participants)
        )
      )
    )
  )
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_blocked_in_conversation(conv_id uuid, uid uuid)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.conversations c, unnest(c.participants) AS p
    WHERE c.id = conv_id
      AND p <> uid
      AND public.is_blocked(uid, p)
  )
$$;

functions.security: SECURITY DEFINER; LANGUAGE sql; STABLE; SET search_path = public

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_create_conversation(parts uuid[], train text, tdate date)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
  SELECT
    parts IS NOT NULL
    AND array_length(parts, 1) = 2
    AND auth.uid() = ANY(parts)
    AND parts[1] <> parts[2]
    AND NOT public.is_blocked(parts[1], parts[2])
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.requests r
      WHERE r.status = 'accepted'
        AND (
          (r.from_user_id = parts[1] AND r.to_user_id = parts[2])
          OR (r.from_user_id = parts[2] AND r.to_user_id = parts[1])
        )
        AND (train IS NULL OR r.train_number = train)
        AND (tdate IS NULL OR r.travel_date = tdate)
    );
$$;
functions.name: public.can_create_conversation
functions.security: SECURITY DEFINER; LANGUAGE sql; STABLE; SET search_path = public
functions.signature: can_create_conversation(parts uuid[], train text, tdate date) RETURNS boolean

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.users_share_journey(a uuid, b uuid, train text, tdate date)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$
  SELECT train IS NOT NULL AND tdate IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.journeys j1
    JOIN public.journeys j2
      ON j1.train_number = j2.train_number
     AND j1.travel_date  = j2.travel_date
    WHERE j1.user_id = a AND j2.user_id = b
      AND j1.train_number = train AND j1.travel_date = tdate
  );
$$;

functions.security: SECURITY DEFINER; LANGUAGE sql; STABLE; SET search_path = public

notes:
AUTH SCHEMA REFERENCES: profiles.id, journeys.user_id, requests.from_user_id/to_user_id, messages.sender_id, last_read.user_id, unverified_trains.submitted_by reference auth.users(id) (ON DELETE CASCADE except unverified_trains.submitted_by). handle_new_user fires AFTER INSERT on auth.users to auto-create the profile row. auth.uid() (derived from auth.jwt()) is used throughout policies and SECURITY DEFINER functions. auth.users.email is the canonical owner-email source because SELECT (email) on public.profiles is revoked from authenticated and anon; profiles_safe view exposes email only to the owner.

DROPPED/SUPERSEDED (do NOT recreate): policies 'Users can view all profiles', 'Users can view all journeys', 'Users can create conversations they participate in', old avatar SELECT policies ('Avatars are publicly accessible' / 'Authenticated users can view avatars'), old trigger 'conversations_prevent_tamper' (replaced by prevent_conversation_tamper_trg); function can_create_conversation(uuid[]) (dropped, replaced by 3-arg version); journeys.user_email column.

KEY HARDENING: (1) conversations UPDATE column-restricted: REVOKE UPDATE (table) from authenticated/anon, GRANT UPDATE only (last_message, last_message_time, deleted_for) to authenticated, GRANT ALL to service_role; deleted_for additionally guarded by prevent_conversation_tamper trigger requiring session flag app.allow_deleted_for_update='on' set only inside soft_delete_conversation(). (2) SECURITY DEFINER helpers revoked from anon/public, granted to authenticated. users_share_journey and can_create_conversation(uuid[],text,date) granted to authenticated AND service_role. handle_new_user revoked from PUBLIC and anon. (3) anon revoked from SELECT on all public data tables + view, and from INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on the DML-relevant subset. (4) GraphQL disabled: COMMENT @graphql({\"visible\": false}) on all tables + profiles_safe view + RLS functions, graphql_public EXECUTE/USAGE revoked from anon/authenticated, then DROP EXTENSION pg_graphql CASCADE. (5) Seed cleanup: DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id='11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'.

AVATARS BUCKET CHRONOLOGY: created public=true (20251227101646) -> public=false (20260106151017) -> public=true (20260106164620) -> public=false FINAL (20260418102918). Final read policy 'Users can view contextual avatars' (owner OR can_view_profile(folder uuid)). chat-attachments bucket is referenced by storage policies but NEVER created in this file (must exist externally; assume private). Object keys are namespaced: avatars = '<user_id>/<file>', chat-attachments = '<conversation_id>/<file>'; policies parse the first path segment.

REALTIME.MESSAGES FINAL POLICY (verbatim, from 20260702121413): CREATE POLICY \"Authenticated users can receive their conversation messages\" ON realtime.messages FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((realtime.topic() LIKE 'messages-%' AND public.is_conversation_participant(NULLIF(replace(realtime.topic(), 'messages-', ''), '')::uuid)) OR (realtime.topic() LIKE 'last-read-%' AND public.is_conversation_participant(substring(realtime.topic() from 11 for 36)::uuid)) OR (realtime.topic() = ('conversations-updates-' || auth.uid()::text)));

BLUEPRINT EDGE CASES: (a) GRANT EXECUTE on can_create_conversation(uuid[]) to authenticated predates its drop - the surviving 3-arg version has its own grants (authenticated, service_role); (b) profiles_safe is the only sanctioned owner-email read path; (c) messages/conversations keep DEFAULT replica identity while last_read is REPLICA IDENTITY FULL (needed for realtime); (d) trains table is seeded with ~200 Indian train rows INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (train_number) DO NOTHING; (e) policies created without a TO clause (roles listed as ['public'] below) apply to all roles including PUBLIC, but table-level SELECT/DML is revoked from anon, so effective access is authenticated-only via table grants; (f) update_updated_at_column was recreated once to add SET search_path = public (mutable-search-path warning fix).
realtimeConfig: Realtime publication 'supabase_realtime' includes tables: public.messages, public.conversations, public.last_read. last_read added conditionally via DO block (checked pg_publication_tables for pubname='supabase_realtime', schemaname='public', tablename='last_read') and has REPLICA IDENTITY FULL (messages and conversations keep default identity). RLS is enabled on realtime.messages (broadcast/presence/postgres_changes payload table) with a single SELECT policy for authenticated users scoping topics: per-conversation 'messages-<conversationId>' via is_conversation_participant; 'last-read-%' topics via is_conversation_participant(substring of topic); per-user 'conversations-updates-<auth.uid()>' topics.

policies: CREATE POLICY "Users can view contextual avatars" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars' AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text OR public.can_view_profile(((storage.foldername(name))[1])::uuid)));
CREATE POLICY "Users can upload their own avatar" ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'avatars' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update their own avatar" ON storage.objects FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);
CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own avatar" ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'avatars' AND auth.uid()::text = (storage.foldername(name))[1]);

CREATE POLICY "Participants can read chat attachments" ON storage.objects FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'chat-attachments' AND public.is_conversation_participant((split_part(name, '/', 1))::uuid));

CREATE POLICY "Participants can upload chat attachments" ON storage.objects FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'chat-attachments' AND public.is_conversation_participant((split_part(name, '/', 1))::uuid) AND owner = auth.uid());
CREATE POLICY "Owners can delete their chat attachments" ON storage.objects FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'chat-attachments' AND owner = auth.uid());

CREATE POLICY "Owners can update their chat attachments" ON storage.objects FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (bucket_id = 'chat-attachments' AND owner = auth.uid() AND public.is_conversation_participant((split_part(name, '/', 1))::uuid)) WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'chat-attachments' AND owner = auth.uid() AND public.is_conversation_participant((split_part(name, '/', 1))::uuid));

summary: TrainMate consolidated Supabase schema (generated 2026-07-23 from supabase/migrations/*). Public schema has 10 tables: profiles, journeys, requests, conversations, messages, last_read, blocked_users, user_reports, trains, unverified_trains. All tables have RLS enabled. Access control is built around SECURITY DEFINER helper functions invoked from RLS policies: is_conversation_participant, can_view_journey, can_view_profile, is_blocked, is_blocked_in_conversation, can_create_conversation(uuid[],text,date), users_share_journey, plus soft_delete_conversation (SECURITY DEFINER RPC) and prevent_conversation_tamper (trigger guard). profiles_safe is a security_invoker view that nulls email for non-owners. Realtime is enabled on messages, conversations, and last_read (last_read with REPLICA IDENTITY FULL); realtime.messages has RLS policy scoping topics to participants. Storage: avatars bucket (private, final state) with contextual read + owner-managed write policies, and chat-attachments bucket policies (bucket created externally). Column-level privileges revoke UPDATE on conversations from authenticated/anon (only last_message, last_message_time, deleted_for grantable), revoke email SELECT on profiles, and anon is revoked from all key tables/functions. GraphQL surface hidden via comments and pg_graphql extension dropped.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.profiles_safe
WITH (security_invoker = on)
AS SELECT 
  id,
  created_at,
  updated_at,
  -- Only show email to the owner of the profile
  CASE WHEN auth.uid() = id THEN email ELSE NULL END as email,
  name,
  college,
  gender,
  bio,
  hobbies,
  avatar_url
FROM public.profiles;
views.name: public.profiles_safe
